selfReview.method: Read the full Japanese-only canonical packet and translated every heading, paragraph, lesson field, question, option and specific rationale directly. Read the connected Filipino teaching prose end to end and compared every field with Japanese for actors, roles, conditions, consent, negation, uncertainty, sequence, recipients and limits. semanticChecks: Bathing purpose retains dirt removal/reduced infection risk plus refreshment, relaxation, satisfaction and life rhythm; washing is not infection prevention proof. Warming effects on vessels/blood flow/metabolism, muscular-joint comfort, digestive function/appetite retain personal variation and no treatment/restoration promise.

Changing-room/bathroom temperature difference and water temperature are separately checked; dry floor is only one condition. Slipperiness/steps/route/support/equipment inspection, damage/position, mobility/sitting ability/staff count and individual plan all remain.

Pre-bath state/wishes/explanation/consent, avoiding empty-stomach/immediate post-meal bathing for digestion/absorption reasons and no staff-free-time override retained. Hydration follows personal conditions/plan, no equal-volume recommendation; clothes/towels prepared with choice.

Toilet wish is asked in advance because urgency may arise during bathing, without forced elimination. Seat/items/person-performed movements checked; exposure is limited to current care, supervision/privacy explained, consent-limited skin observation and specific location/state reported to medical professional retained.
Changed state/unsafe conditions prevent forcing completion; facility procedures for required help/medical contact retained, text-only unpractised transfer/bathing not authorized.

Grooming preserves face/hair/beard/nails/clothes/oral hygiene and identity/social connection. Clothing protection/temperature regulation/season/activity/body/feelings/comfort/mobility and no age-only choices retained. Habits/cosmetics/hair/values and remaining functions retained without all-function improvement promise.

Dressing assistance does not transfer choice rights. Person chooses color/order and retains possible movements; consent to hair does not cover all makeup/clothing changes. Refusal and current wishes separated; exposure/pain/fatigue/stop wish and post-care tightness/wrinkles/comfort/skin checked beyond button completion.

Housework IADL and diverse habits/wishes are not evaluated by task count. Cooking sequence menu→ingredients→cooking→plating/serving→cleanup retained; state/illness/allergies/preference/treatment/form conditions not independently altered. Prolonged boiling is not universal absorption benefit.

Country/region/individual taste differences, seasonal/festival meaning and osechi as example not universal rule retained. Cleaning dirt removal and familiar belongings/comfort, consent to what stays/moves/disposal, glasses permission distinct from cleaning request, wheelchair user can state wishes retained.

Laundry includes clothes/sheets/bedding and collection/material-label washing/drying/clean return separate. Handwash/outdoor-dry illustration is not all-material method or disinfection proof. Blood/feces/vomit contamination requires standard precautions before diagnosis, PPE/hand hygiene/collection, clean-dirty flows and task-risk/facility methods.

Dirty linen no excess shaking/spreading, quiet handling/container or bag retained; concentration/temperature not inferred from image, product/material/facility instructions checked. Access/steps/bath/toilet/slip resistance/handrails, rug edge snag risk with personal gait not all-rugs verdict, temperature/humidity/ventilation/privacy/mental comfort and activity-enabling aids preserved.

Dignity/rights remain when care is needed; person is active subject, staff values not imposed. QOL includes satisfaction/happiness/life meaning beyond motion count/health values. Normalization protects rights and community identity, not uniform behavior/preferences.

Physical and mental independence separated; ability/will/needed support, daily-routine illustration not same-time mandate, health/housework/housing/family/community/culture/history differences retained. Receiving support may affect confidence/motivation but not universal passivity; meaningful desired activity and autonomy with safety remain.

Privacy exposure only current necessary area and observation explained; personal data sharing need/recipient/scope/consent/procedure, no task-consent expansion to photo/other channel, personal social media/private contacts not permitted merely by removing name, defined route/recipient and no overheard detail retained.

Restraint examples retain tying hands/feet, bed barriers to prevent exit, locked exit, standing-prevention belt and excessive behavior-suppressing medicine; purpose/actual restriction beyond equipment name, possible physical/mental harm and dementia distress/confusion, no guaranteed improvement from safety justification, organization considers restraint-free support.

All five abuse categories and concrete examples retained. Withholding necessary food to compel obedience involves neglected care and fear; multiple categories and protection priority retained. Suspicion triggers safety/seen-heard facts/time/person words separate, no wait for self legal conclusion; urgency calls immediate facility emergency help/medical connection.

Facility reporting plus suspicion-appropriate municipal consultation/authority reporting route/procedure retained; privacy does not stop necessary safety/reporting, minimum necessary information to proper office, text does not substitute individual legal decision.

Team centered on desired life: doctor diagnosis/treatment; nurse illness care/clinical assistance with doctor/dentist instructions where required; care worker observes/reports, no independent diagnosis/treatment change. PT movement/OT daily activities/ST language-hearing-swallowing distinct and complementary.

Registered dietitian nutrition/energy/form/menu, cooking staff assigned checked conditions, care worker actual eating/amount/wishes retained. Dentist assessment/treatment and denture pain/mouth lesion location/person complaint lead to check, no care-worker grinding/adjusting dentures or independent treatment.

Care manager/social worker consultation/service coordination/use plan, person discussion and necessary family/contacts retained, family view not automatically replacing person wishes. Dysphagia/unclear food form observation and unconfirmed instruction to responsible staff, nurse/dietitian/ST evaluation/current plan, no unilateral chopping/thickening/energy change retained.

Coordinated service plan is not proof of delivery; contact/confirmed conditions/implementation results separated, observed fact versus inference. Knowing ST role gives no added menu-change authority; clarify who confirms which instruction.

Home visit/day attendance/residential care location/timing/content and actual service examples retained; category name does not certify individual eligibility, responsible staff checks. Assessment gathers/analyzes personal life issues; person goals/specific support plan→implementation→response/state/result/goal-based suitability evaluation retained.

Implementation count or plan document alone does not demonstrate effect/goal attainment. Insufficient information returns to information gathering/goals/method review; process repeats for personal life. Scheduled/implemented/achieved remain distinct, with full four specific care-process rationales preserving assessment versus plan versus implementation versus evaluation.
